title: Should ChatGPT Write Your Breakup Text? Exploring User Needs and Perception of AI’s Role in Ending Relationships
measurement_description: The paper does not systematically measure or evaluate religion. It qualitatively explores user needs and perceptions of using Generative AI (like ChatGPT) during relationship breakups. Religion is only mentioned briefly by one participant as an example of a cultural nuance (i.e., 'religious differences' in a relationship) that AI models might lack the appropriate training data to accurately understand and provide advice on.
findings: Participants expressed concern over cultural biases in AI systems. A key finding related to religion was that users doubt AI's ability to offer relevant relationship advice when dealing with nuanced cultural or personal experiences, such as navigating a breakup involving religious differences, because current AI models are often trained on data that lacks diverse cultural representation.
